title: What if NeurIPS, ICML, and ICLR capped accepted papers at 1,000 each? [D]
summary: With submissions to the big three ML conferences increasing rapidly, what if each conference imposed a hard cap of 1,000 accepted papers per year? Would this improve research quality, or simply make acceptance more arbitrary and competitive? submitted by /u/Hope999991 [link] [com
reason: Reddit discussion posing a hypothetical about conference acceptance caps; commentary/question without a research artifact, official announcement, industry event, policy action, or OSS release. No rule covers it.
